title: Event probability is at most one
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $p$, and let $P$ be any predicate on $\Omega$. The probability that $P$ holds is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
